summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of NENO SPACE community management dashboard. All core features working correctly including authentication, navigation, data display, filters, and user interactions.
passed_tests: Login page loads with split-screen layout (branding left, form right)
Login with correct credentials (admin@nenospace.com / admin123) redirects to dashboard
Login with incorrect credentials shows error message
Dashboard page shows 6 stat cards with correct mock data
Sidebar navigation works - all nav items navigate to correct pages
Members page shows table with all 16 members from mock data
Members search filter works (tested with 'Jean' search)
Members station filter dropdown works
Members status filter works
Members generation filter works
Add Member dialog opens and closes properly
Click View on member navigates to member detail page
Member Detail page shows profile info and editable fields
Edit Profile button toggles edit mode on member detail page
Back button on member detail navigates back to members list
Stations page shows 9 station cards in grid layout
Zones page shows 4 zone cards
Teachings page shows 8 teachings in table format
Administration page shows 4 admin users table with dropdown actions
Profile page shows tabs (General, Security, Notifications)
Logout from user dropdown menu redirects to login page
Protected routes redirect to login when not authenticated
